newsitem.title: USA: Santander arranges Bavaria SA loan syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Santander arranges Bavaria SA loan syndicate.

text.p: Santander Investment Securities Inc said on Friday it had arranged a US$400 million loan syndication for Bavaria SA, a Colombia-based consumer products and beverage company.

Bavaria is also engaged through subsidiaries in aviation, banking and financial services, telecommunications, automobile assembly, heavy industry, petroleum and petrochemicals, insurance, construction and foodstuffs, Santander said.
Approximately US$350 million of the capital raised for Bavaria will be used to repay debt while the remaining US$50 million will be put toward working capital purposes."
